alert.en: I feel wide awake and alert.
I heard a sound and looked around.
alert.zh: 我听到一个声音，就四处看了看。

amused.zh: 再给我讲一个好玩的故事吧！

animated.en: I cannot stop dancing to this song.
animated.zh: 这首歌让我忍不住跳舞。

appreciative.zh: 我真的很感谢你的帮助。

appreciative.en: You made this easier for me.
appreciative.zh: 有你帮忙，这件事容易多了。

appreciative.en: Thank you for being so kind.

ardent.en: I care about this a lot.
I love talking about my favorite hobby.
ardent.zh: 我特别喜欢聊自己热爱的事情。

ardent.en: May I tell you why I love it?
ardent.zh: 我能告诉你我为什么喜欢它吗？

aroused.en: Something stirred up a big feeling in me.
aroused.zh: 有件事让我心里起了很大的波澜。

aroused.en: I am not sure how to name this feeling.
aroused.zh: 我还不知道怎么形容这种感觉。

aroused.en: Can you help me understand it?

astonished.en: Wow, I did not expect that!
That magic trick left me speechless.
astonished.zh: 那个魔术让我惊讶得说不出话。

blissful.en: Eating my favorite ice cream makes me smile.
blissful.zh: 吃到最喜欢的冰淇淋，我开心极了。

blissful.en: I wish this moment could last longer.
blissful.zh: 真希望这一刻再长一点。

breathless.en: I need a moment to catch my breath.
That race made me breathe so fast.
Can we slow down for a bit?

buoyant.en: I feel light and cheerful today.
That good news lifted my spirits.
buoyant.zh: 这个好消息让我精神一振。

buoyant.en: I am ready for something fun!
buoyant.zh: 我已经准备好玩点有趣的了！

carefree.en: I do not have a worry right now.
Running in the park feels so free.

carefree.zh: 我们好好享受这个下午吧！

comfortable.en: This soft chair feels just right.
comfortable.zh: 这把软椅子坐着真舒服。

comfortable.en: Can I stay here a little longer?
comfortable.zh: 我能在这里多待一会儿吗？

complacent.en: I thought I had done enough.
complacent.zh: 我原以为自己做得够好了。

complacent.en: I stopped checking my work too early.
complacent.zh: 我太早就不检查作业了。

complacent.en: Maybe I should take another look.

composed.en: I took a breath before answering.
composed.zh: 回答前我先深吸了一口气。

composed.en: I can handle this one step at a time.

concerned-met.en: I care about how you feel.
You seem quiet today; are you okay?
concerned-met.zh: 你今天有点安静，还好吗？

cool.en: I feel pretty cool in this outfit.
cool.zh: 穿上这身衣服，我觉得自己挺酷。

cool.en: What do you think of my style?
cool.zh: 你觉得我这样穿怎么样？

dazzled.en: Wow, the lights are so bright!

dazzled.zh: 闪亮的表演让我看呆了。

ebullient.en: I have so much good news to share.
Can I tell you all about it?
ebullient.zh: 我能一口气讲给你听吗？

ecstatic.en: I am happier than I can say!
ecstatic.zh: 我开心得不知道怎么说了！

ecstatic.en: I can hardly believe we won.
ecstatic.zh: 我简直不敢相信我们赢了。

effervescent.en: I cannot stop laughing with my friends.
effervescent.zh: 和朋友在一起，我笑个不停。

elated.en: I feel so happy and proud!
We finally finished our big project.
elated.zh: 我们终于完成那个大作品啦。

elated.en: Can I show you what we made?
elated.zh: 我能给你看看我们的作品吗？

enchanted.en: The glowing garden has me spellbound.
enchanted.zh: 闪闪发光的花园让我看入迷了。

enchanted.en: Can we explore a little more?

encouraged.en: I feel ready to try again.
Your words helped me believe in myself.
encouraged.zh: 你的话让我更相信自己。

encouraged.en: Thank you for cheering me on.

energetic.en: I have so much energy today!
I want to jump and run outside.

engrossed.en: I am really into this story.
engrossed.zh: 这个故事让我看入迷了。

engrossed.en: I did not even hear the bell.
engrossed.zh: 我专心得连铃声都没听见。

engrossed.en: Can I read one more page?

enlivened.zh: 那段音乐让我精神一振！

enlivened.en: I felt sleepy, but now I want to dance.
enlivened.zh: 刚才还有点困，现在我想跳舞了。

enlivened.en: Let's turn the music on again!

enthusiastic.en: I cannot wait to get started!
I have so many ideas for our project.
enthusiastic.zh: 我们的作品我有好多点子。

exhilarated.en: That was such an exciting ride!
exhilarated.zh: 刚才的游乐设施太刺激了！

exhilarated.en: My heart was racing in a happy way.
Can we tell everyone about it?

expansive.en: I feel open and friendly today.
expansive.zh: 今天我很想和大家交朋友。

expansive.en: I enjoyed meeting the new children.
expansive.zh: 认识新朋友让我很开心。

expansive.en: Would you like to join us?

expectant.en: I am looking forward to tomorrow.
I keep wondering what the trip will be like.
expectant.zh: 我一直在想旅行会是什么样。

expectant.en: What are you looking forward to?

exultant.en: Our team scored the winning point.
exultant.zh: 我们队拿到了制胜的一分。

friendly.en: I smiled and said hello to the new child.
friendly.zh: 我笑着向新同学打招呼。

friendly.en: Would you like to play with us?

fulfilled.en: I feel satisfied with what I made.
fulfilled.zh: 我对自己的作品很满足。

fulfilled.en: May I show it to you?

glad.en: I am glad you are here.
Your thank-you note made me smile.
glad.zh: 你的感谢小纸条让我笑了。

glad.en: Shall we do something fun together?

gleeful.en: That silly game is so much fun.
gleeful.zh: 那个搞笑的游戏真好玩。

glorious.en: I feel proud of this moment.

glorious.zh: 我们终于完成了一件难事。

glowing.zh: 我高兴得脸上都发光了！

glowing.en: I feel proud of what I did today.
glowing.zh: 我为今天的表现感到自豪。

good-humored.en: I am in a cheerful mood.
I can laugh at my own silly mistake.
good-humored.zh: 我连自己闹的小笑话都能笑出来。

gratified.en: I am happy with how it turned out.
Our plan worked just the way we hoped.
gratified.zh: 我们的计划和希望的一样成功了。

helpful.en: I can carry some of those books.
What can I do to help you?

inquisitive.en: I wonder why the moon changes shape.
inquisitive.zh: 我想知道月亮为什么会变形。

inquisitive.en: Could we look it up together?

intense-met.zh: 我现在有一种很强烈的感觉。

intense-met.en: That story stayed in my mind all day.
intense-met.zh: 那个故事让我一整天都忘不掉。

intense-met.en: Could I tell you what moved me?
intense-met.zh: 我能讲讲它为什么打动我吗？

intrigued.en: I want to know what happens next.
intrigued.zh: 我真想知道接下来会怎样。

invigorated.en: I feel fresh and full of energy!
A good night's sleep helped me feel better.
Want to go for a walk?

involved.en: I want to be part of this.
Everyone is building the model together.
Is there a job I can help with?
involved.zh: 有没有我能帮忙的地方？

joyous.en: This is such a joyful day!
We have been laughing together all morning.

joyous.zh: 我们再一起创造开心的回忆吧！

jubilant.en: Everyone cheered when the game ended.
jubilant.zh: 比赛结束时大家都欢呼起来。

keyed-up.en: I feel excited and a little jumpy.
The race is about to start.
Can we take one deep breath first?
keyed-up.zh: 我们先深呼吸一下好吗？

loving.en: I feel so much love for my family.
I like sitting close to them.
Can I give you a hug?

mellow.en: I feel peaceful and gentle today.
mellow.zh: 今天我心里很柔和、平静。

mellow.en: The warm afternoon makes me sleepy.
mellow.zh: 暖暖的下午让我有点想睡。

mellow.en: Shall we listen to some quiet music?
mellow.zh: 我们听点轻柔的音乐好吗？

merry.en: I am in a happy, festive mood!
merry.zh: 我今天很有节日的好心情！

merry.en: The party music makes me smile.
merry.zh: 派对音乐让我笑开了花。

mirthful.en: I am full of laughter today!
My friend just told a silly joke.
mirthful.zh: 朋友刚讲了个好笑的笑话。

moved.zh: 那个故事真的让我感动。

moved.en: I felt tears in my eyes at the ending.
moved.zh: 看到结尾我眼眶都湿了。

moved.en: Can I tell you which part I loved?
moved.zh: 我能说说最喜欢哪一段吗？

optimistic.en: I think things can get better.
optimistic.zh: 我相信事情会慢慢好起来。

optimistic.en: Today was hard, but tomorrow is another chance.
optimistic.zh: 今天虽然难，明天还有机会。

overjoyed.en: I am so happy I could jump!
I got the news I was waiting for.
overjoyed.zh: 我等了好久的好消息终于来了。

overwhelmed-met.en: I have so many happy feelings at once!
overwhelmed-met.zh: 我一下子涌上好多开心的感觉！

overwhelmed-met.en: Everyone surprised me on my birthday.
overwhelmed-met.zh: 大家在我生日这天给了我惊喜。

overwhelmed-met.en: I need a moment to take it all in.
overwhelmed-met.zh: 让我缓一缓，好好感受这一切。

peaceful.en: The house is quiet early in the morning.
Can we enjoy this quiet for a while?
peaceful.zh: 我们能安静地待一会儿吗？

perky.en: I jumped out of bed ready to play.
perky.zh: 我一早起来就想出去玩。

pleasant.en: The breeze on my face is so gentle.
Want to sit here for a while?

pleased.en: I am pleased with my work.
pleased.zh: 我对自己的作品很满意。

pleased.en: I tried hard, and it turned out well.
Can I show you what I did?
pleased.zh: 我能给你看看我做的吗？

quiet.en: I want a little quiet time.
Could we turn the volume down?

radiant.en: I cannot stop smiling after that surprise.
radiant.zh: 那个惊喜让我笑个不停。

radiant.en: May I tell you the good news?
radiant.zh: 我能告诉你那个好消息吗？

rapturous.en: This is the happiest surprise I have had all week.
rapturous.zh: 这是我这周最开心的惊喜。
快来和我们一起庆祝吧！

refreshed.en: That nap helped me get my energy back.
refreshed.zh: 睡了一小觉，我又有力气了。

refreshed.en: I am ready to play again!

satisfied.en: I finished my meal and feel just right.
I am happy with how things turned out.

secure.en: Being with my family helps me relax.
secure.zh: 和家人在一起让我很放心。

secure.en: Can we stay together a little longer?
secure.zh: 我们能再一起待一会儿吗？

sensitive-met.en: I felt tears in my eyes at the ending.
sensitive-met.zh: 看到结尾我眼眶都湿了。

sensitive-met.en: Can I tell you why it mattered to me?
sensitive-met.zh: 我能说说它为什么打动我吗？

serene.en: Watching the sunset makes me slow down.
serene.zh: 看日落让我慢慢放松下来。
我们一起安静地看好吗？

spellbound.en: I cannot take my eyes off this!

spellbound.zh: 魔术师的表演太神奇了。

spellbound.en: Can we stay until it is over?

splendid.en: The fireworks light up the sky.
splendid.zh: 烟花把夜空照得亮亮的。

stimulated.zh: 这件事让我开始动脑筋！

stimulated.en: I learned something new in class today.
stimulated.zh: 今天课上我学到了新东西。

stimulated.en: Can we try a little experiment?

surprised-met.en: I had no idea you made this for me.
surprised-met.zh: 我完全不知道你为我准备了这个。

surprised-met.en: How did you keep it a secret?

tender.en: I feel very gentle toward the kitten.
tender.zh: 看到小猫，我心里软软的。

tender.en: I want to pet it carefully.
Is it okay if I touch it?

thrilled.zh: 刚才坐过山车太刺激了。

thrilled.en: Can I tell you how it felt?
thrilled.zh: 我能告诉你是什么感觉吗？

touched.en: That was so kind of you.
Your note made me feel loved.
touched.zh: 你的小纸条让我感到被爱。

touched.en: Thank you for thinking of me.

tranquil.en: The lake is smooth in the morning light.
tranquil.zh: 晨光里的湖面平静极了。

tranquil.en: Can we sit and listen to the birds?
tranquil.zh: 我们坐着听听鸟叫好吗？

trusting.en: I know I can trust you.
You kept the promise you made.
May I tell you something important?
trusting.zh: 我能告诉你一件重要的事吗？

upbeat.en: My favorite song lifted my mood.
upbeat.zh: 最喜欢的歌让我心情变好了。

warm.en: Can we snuggle up and read?
warm.zh: 我们裹着毯子看书好吗？

wide-awake.en: A good sleep left me full of energy.
wide-awake.zh: 睡了个好觉，我精神十足。

wide-awake.en: Are you ready to start the day?
wide-awake.zh: 准备好开始新的一天了吗？

wonderful.en: I loved every moment of our trip.
wonderful.zh: 这次旅行的每一刻我都很喜欢。

zestful.en: I feel full of energy and excitement!
Playing football makes me come alive.
Come play a game with me!
